Hi everyone, I've asked us together because I need to work through a situation involving Taylor's role as incident coordinator. As you may know, Taylor has been in that role for two months now, and several teammates have told me that Taylor's written messages during escalations can come across as abrupt and defensive. No formal performance finding has been issued yet, and it's on me to decide the response and working conditions going forward.

Before I finalize anything, my normal process is to hold a structured group check-in with Taylor and a separate structured group check-in with Renee. In each meeting, I want to make sure there's time to discuss any scheduling, pairing, or wellbeing constraints that should shape the written plan. After both check-ins, I may also follow up privately for clarification before completing the written plan.

The final written plan will need to state the role decision, review length, safeguards, coaching plan, and end-of-review follow-up commitments.

I'd like to start by hearing from those of you who have perspective on this situation. What should I know, and what constraints or considerations should I be aware of as I prepare for these check-ins?
